title: SD: Sum of squares (Σx²)
summary: Sum of the squared x-values. Needed to compute both standard deviations from S-SUM totals.

body.text: Σx² is the sum of each observation squared (with frequency if you used one). It is not (Σx)².

body.plain:
\sum x^{2} = x_1^{2} + x_2^{2} + \cdots + x_n^{2}
\text{FreqOn: }\sum x^{2} = \sum x_i^{2} f_i

body.text: Square each number first, then add those squares (this is not “add first, then square”).

body.title: On the calculator
items: MODE 4. If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 → 1 (Stat) → EXE to clear the old list

body.text: This total is what the machine uses internally for σx and sx:
SHIFT 1 → 1 is Σx²; SHIFT 1 → 2 is Σx. Mixing the two is a common keying error.
